narration: You are born inside an egg buried in a muddy mound on the edge of a mangrove swamp in Northern Australia.
scene: A crocodile egg buried in a mud mound, mangrove roots behind it
label: NORTHERN AUSTRALIA

narration: The nest is a stinking pile of rotting leaves and mud your mother kicked together a few months ago.
scene: A big stinking nest mound of mud and leaves, steam/smell lines
label: THE NEST

narration: She's long gone now. She doesn't care about you. She cares about the next meal.
scene: A large stick-figure mother crocodile swimming away, tiny egg behind her, thought bubble of a fish meal
label: GOODBYE MOM

narration: You crack open the shell using a tiny egg-tooth on the tip of your snout.
scene: Close-up of an egg cracking, tiny snout with egg-tooth poking through
label: EGG-TOOTH

narration: It's a temporary feature that serves one purpose and one purpose only: to get you out of this humid tomb.
scene: Diagram: egg-tooth labeled with an arrow, pointing to a cramped egg interior
label: ONE JOB

narration: You're about 10 inches long. You weigh less than a candy bar.
scene: Tiny stick-figure croc beside a full-size candy bar for comparison
label: 10 INCHES

narration: You have no idea what's waiting above.
scene: Tiny hatchling at the bottom of the frame looking up at dark silhouettes of birds in a bright sky

narration: Around you, dozens of other hatchlings are also breaking free. Siblings. Roommates. Future competition.
scene: Many stick-figure hatchlings emerging from eggs, looking at each other warily
label: SIBLINGS

narration: You all claw your way up through the mud, emerging into blinding sunlight and immediate danger.
scene: Hatchlings climbing out of a mud nest into blazing sun rays
label: UP AND OUT

scene: Single exhausted hatchling standing in sunlight, dramatic shadow behind it
label: FOR NOW
